clue.text: Relatively artless post-impressionist, so to speak

blocks.note: first meaning: more candid, comparative of an adjective for open and plain-spoken

explanation.surface: An art critic remarks that a certain Post-Impressionist painter was comparatively naive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Post-impressionist' suggests Gauguin or Cézanne; split it and it is someone who impresses post, a machine or clerk that marks letters to show postage is paid.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank means candid and without guile, so the comparative describes someone comparatively open; a franking machine stamps mail.

clue.text: Daggers drawn, critically
